description:
Query active behavior execution status, history, or full tree node traversal state (actions: current, history, tree_state). Use get_status instead of get_metrics when inspecting active execution state and node traversal paths rather than aggregated runtime performance telemetry.

Returns execution status, current node path, tick counters, duration, and error states.

action.description: Status query mode: current, history, tree_state

execution_id.description: Target execution ID (or latest if omitted)

name: get_status
